public_rationale: Southen's December 22 posts describe a 15-minute demonstration and an additional Batman example following Joker and Thanos, using simple prompts. Reporting preserved from December 23 corroborates close resemblance to film originals. This supports quick, straightforward repetition across films. It does not establish that every attempt succeeded or that the outputs were pixel-identical.
limitations: Visual similarity is corroborated through reporting; the original image attachments were not inspectable in the required text reader.
There is no complete attempt count or measured replication rate.
Later Dune demonstrations and the January investigation were not used to establish the prepublication result.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Southen quickly showed that the pattern of Midjourney reproducing copyrighted film imagery could be easily replicated, multiple times with multiple films.

statement.excerpt: Southen quickly showed that the whole pattern could be easily replicated, multiple times with multiple films.
statement.document_title: An artist fights back, and Midjourney has embarrassed themselves

from_speaker: the whole pattern could be easily replicated
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that Southen readily produced multiple close reproductions across at least two films during the initial episode.
Quickly refers to the roughly one-day sequence described in the post, giving a target period of December 22–23, 2023.
Replication means recurring close resemblance across examples. It does not require identical outputs on every attempt or a particular statistical success rate.
The assessment concerns visual reproduction, not a judicial determination of copyright infringement.
criteria.support_condition: Dated demonstrations establish repeated close reproductions across more than one film within the initial episode, with evidence that the process was straightforward.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish that the examples did not span multiple films, were not close reproductions, arose only after publication, or required substantial work inconsistent with easy replication.

This earlier demonstration supplies a concrete indication of speed. Together with the additional-film post on the same date, it supports the claim's short timeline.
